Build a ScreenR Object

Source: R/screenr-class.R
build_screenr_object.Rd

Internal function that builds a screenr_object from the tables, without checking them (the checks are done by create_screenr_object).

Usage

build_screenr_object(
  count_table = NULL,
  annotation_table = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  replicates = c(""),
  normalized_count_table = NULL,
  data_table = NULL,
  sample_table = NULL,
  column_names = list()
)

Arguments

count_table

A table with a Barcode column and one column for each sample. Non-numeric columns other than Barcode are ignored.

annotation_table

The annotation table, with a Barcode column.

groups

The groups of the samples.

replicates

The replicates.

normalized_count_table

An optional normalized count table, with a Barcode column; it is matched to the count table by barcode and sample.

data_table

The data table.

sample_table

An optional sample table with the columns Sample, Day and Treatment, in the order of the samples; when NULL the sample names are parsed.

column_names

The original column names.

Value

A screenr_object.
